files.content:
# ShyneTyme — 8×32 WS2812B Matrix Options

**Status:** Selection document. Proposed effects are not necessarily built into the referenced libraries. No firmware has been compiled or flashed.

## Verified source projects

- Adafruit NeoMatrix: https://github.com/adafruit/Adafruit_NeoMatrix — pixel matrix layout, text and GFX integration.
- Adafruit GFX: https://github.com/adafruit/Adafruit-GFX-Library — fonts, pixel drawing, lines, rectangles, circles, triangles, bitmaps.
- Adafruit NeoPixel: https://github.com/adafruit/Adafruit_NeoPixel — WS2812B pixel driver.
- FastLED: https://github.com/FastLED/FastLED — procedural pixel effects and color palettes.
- PIXELIX: https://github.com/BlueAndi/Pixelix — ESP32 32×8 matrix text, GIF/icon animations, playlists via extensible plugins (reference architecture; not a drop-in BLE addition).
- ESP32 Pixel Matrix: https://github.com/ogulcanaydogan/esp32-pixel-matrix — reference effects and pixel art (8×8 implementation; adaptation needed).

## Proposed effects for ShyneTyme

### Text and typography
1. Static text, centered or aligned
2. Scroll left
3. Scroll right
4. Bounce horizontally
5. Typewriter reveal
6. Blink text
7. Rainbow characters
8. Color-cycle text
9. Gradient text
10. Wipe reveal
11. Slide in/out
12. Character-by-character pop
13. Marquee border + text
14. Alternating two-line messages (small font dependent)
15. Text + animated background

### Pixel animations and icons
16. Solid color
17. Rainbow sweep
18. Rainbow wave
19. Color pulse/breathing
20. Sparkles/twinkle
21. Falling rain
22. Matrix-style digital rain
23. Fire simulation
24. Plasma/noise animation
25. Confetti
26. Moving stripes
27. Checkerboard animation
28. Expanding circles
29. Moving pixel sprite
30. Heart pulse
31. Smiley animation
32. Arrow sequence
33. Alert strobe
34. Equalizer-style bars (simulated unless audio input is provided)
35. Custom bitmap/icon frames
36. GIF-derived frames (requires conversion/storage and performance validation)

## Playback architecture requested
- Exactly one active effect at a time.
- BLE command chooses effect, text, foreground/background color, speed, brightness and direction.
- Named presets save effect + parameters + text.
- Playlist contains ordered preset IDs and duration for each item; repeat/shuffle optional.
- Nonblocking `millis()` scheduling to preserve BLE responsiveness.
- Persistence via ESP32 Preferences/NVS after memory budget and storage format are verified.
- Do not replace existing BLE protocol or effects without comparing original sketch.

## Physical mapping and integration
- Matrix is 32 columns × 8 rows, 256 WS2812B pixels.
- Need to confirm serpentine/progressive order, first-pixel corner, rotation and GPIO before selecting NeoMatrix constructor flags.
- Existing reported GPIO13/300-LED output must not be silently reassigned. If banner is an additional physical output, use a separately verified pin and LED driver; if it replaces the existing output, explicitly confirm.
- Avoid simultaneously initializing two libraries to drive the same pin and LEDs. A shared frame buffer or single driver owner is preferred.
- Adafruit GFX and NeoMatrix do not supply Bluetooth. Retain the existing ESP32 BLE stack and command service.

## Proposed BLE command vocabulary (not yet existing firmware commands)
```
MATRIX MODE 02
MATRIX TEXT SHYNETYME
MATRIX COLOR FF6600
MATRIX SPEED 40
MATRIX BRIGHTNESS 64
MATRIX PRESET SAVE 01
MATRIX PRESET LOAD 01
MATRIX PLAYLIST 01,02,05,07
MATRIX PLAY
MATRIX STOP
```

## Selection and build gate
Select effect IDs and preferred palette/text. Recover actual V5.2/V5.3 source (or its matching binary and source package) before a non-destructive merge. Compile against the actual ESP32 board/core and installed library versions, verify BLE and matrix output, then flash only after approval.
